label: Codex approval review: HMS bulk snapshot script for disposable Windows VM DB recovery
summary: Approved a sequence of Codex exec_command/apply_patch requests for a disposable-instance snapshot script: transferring a base64-chunked PowerShell script to a unique Windows temp path via prlctl and executing it with scoped execution-policy bypass to create/verify reversible DB snapshots. Chunk size was reduced (900→300 bytes) after transfer failures, then the transport mechanism itself was patched from prlctl exec/base64 chunking to scp+ssh (host 'hms-vm') after repeated failures even with a healthy VM/SQL endpoint. All requests assessed medium risk/high authorization/allow — no source-database mutation or exfiltration, reversible snapshots only.
